### John Eats the Scroll
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/john-eats-the-scroll
Passage: Revelation 10:8-11
Points:
- God's declaration that there is no delay shows we are living in the final era of redemptive history.
- The open scroll is directly linked to the scroll of divine judgment opened in Revelation 5.
- Just as Ezekiel did, John must thoroughly consume and digest God's message before proclaiming it.
- Receiving God's Word is sweet, but its message brings bitterness because it reveals judgment on the world.
- Faithful believers are called to receive and proclaim the whole counsel of Scripture, even its difficult truths.

### Bible Pathways 12/26/2001
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-12-or-26-or-2001-1127346.html
Passage: Revelation 10:8-11
Points:
- Eating the little scroll symbolizes fully understanding, digesting, and applying God's Word to our lives.
- Scripture carries a dual message: wonderfully sweet to those saved by Christ, yet bitter to those who reject Him.
- John was prepared to prophesy to peoples and nations only after taking God's message deeply into himself.
- Despite the growth of wickedness and opposition in the last days, believers have peace knowing God remains sovereign.
